summary: Blue Gold Ltd filed a Form 6-K reporting results of an extraordinary general meeting and an annual general meeting held July 24, 2026. Shareholders approved a reverse stock split with a ratio between 1:2 and 1:200, with the board authorized to set the final ratio within a year. The EGM also approved charter amendments reflecting the split. The AGM re-elected director Candice Beaumont. This is a routine corporate governance matter, not a special situation. No deal terms are present.
